# MERIDIA

> MERIDIA is a concept European menswear brand (business casual, quiet luxury), created as a
> university project. The online store is a demonstration: no real orders, payments or shipments.
> Brand line: "European sensibility. Timeless design. Everyday sophistication."

## The collection (Spring/Summer 27 capsule, prices in EUR)
- Portofino Striped Polo — knitted cotton polo, navy/cream stripes — 89 €
- Amalfi Striped Linen Shirt — washed European linen, fine stripe — 119 €
- Sorrento Linen Sweater — open-knit linen and cotton crewneck — 149 €
- Riviera Cotton Cap — washed cotton twill, six panels, no logo — 45 €
- Capri Braided Bracelet — hand-braided waxed cord, brass clasp — 59 €

## Store policies (as shown on the site)
- Free standard shipping over 149 €, otherwise 6.90 €; express 14.90 €
- Delivery estimate: 2–4 working days in Italy, 3–6 across Europe
- Free returns within 14 days of delivery
- Multi-piece discount: 10% off with 2 pieces, 15% off with 3 or more
- Sizes XS–XL; the size guide includes measurements and a size finder
- Languages: Italian (default) and English
